label: Bible Study
prompt: And when the _____, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
verse: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
note: A Roman officer at the foot of the cross gives the Gospel's great verdict.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will _____ in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verse: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
note: Sing and rejoice, Zion — God is coming to dwell in the midst of thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: He opened the _____, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verse: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
note: The psalm remembers Moses' rock: God opened it, and water ran through the desert like a river.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin _____ at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verse: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
note: God warns Cain before the first murder: sin lies in wait at the door — yet he can still rule over it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The wind bloweth where it _____, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verse: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
note: 'The wind bloweth where it listeth' — where it pleases. Jesus to Nicodemus, by night, on being born of the Spirit.
